commentary.text: 90+5' That's it for today, Chris Kavanagh has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+2' Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
90+2' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked. The ball goes out of play. Manchester Utd are awarded a corner kick.
90+1' Crystal Palace work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
90+1' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked. The linesman makes the right call and Crystal Palace will have a corner.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
88' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Donny van de Beek (Manchester United) replaces Victor Lindelof.
88' Roy Hodgson has decided to make a change. Chris Richards (Crystal Palace) replaces Eberechi Eze.
87' Here comes a substitution. Harry Maguire (Manchester United) is brought on as a substitute for Raphael Varane.
86' The Manchester Utd players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
84' 76:24 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
80' Eberechi Eze sends the free kick into the box. Joachim Andersen (Crystal Palace) outjumps the defence to win the header, but completely mistimes the ball and sends it high over the bar.
79' Sofyan Amrabat (Manchester United) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him. Crystal Palace have a free kick.
78' Here's the change. Jeffrey Schlupp leaves the pitch and Jairo Riedewald (Crystal Palace) comes on as a substitute.
77' Erik ten Hag decides to make a substitution. Marcus Rashford will be replaced by Christian Eriksen (Manchester United).
77' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Mason Mount as he is replaced by Anthony Martial (Manchester United).
77' Mason Mount (Manchester United) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
76' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
76' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition. Manchester Utd have a corner.
75' The opposition back off Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) and he lashes in a shot from the edge of the box that just flies a whisker wide of the left post. Unlucky!
74' Raphael Varane (Manchester United) rises above the defence inside the box, but his header flies narrowly wide of the left post.
74' The resulting corner, taken by Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United), comes to nothing.
73' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears. Manchester Utd will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
70' Mason Mount (Manchester United) meets a cross from Diogo Dalot, but he cannot keep his header on target. It goes high over the crossbar.
69' The linesman raises his flag. Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) is adjudged offside.
68' A pass from Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) is intercepted by Sam Johnstone and the move breaks down.
66' 12:6 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
64' Eberechi Eze sends over an inswinging corner and Jeffrey Schlupp (Crystal Palace) gets his head on the ball, but it goes just wide of the right post.
64' Corner kick. Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) is ready to send the ball into the box.

64' Jeffrey Schlupp (Crystal Palace) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. The ball goes behind for a corner. Crystal Palace will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
63' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the roof of the net, but Andre Onana is well positioned to make a comfortable save.

62' Some great play by Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) ends with a shot on the edge of the box low towards the middle of the net, but Sam Johnstone sees it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
61' We are about to witness a subsitution. Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) for Facundo Pellistri.
60' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
59' That looked a certain handball by Joel Ward (Crystal Palace) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
58' Mason Mount (Manchester United) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.

57' Facundo Pellistri (Manchester United) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. Now Manchester Utd have a corner.
57' Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) rises above the defence and heads a precise cross towards the left post. His effort, however, is blocked by Sam Johnstone, who pulls off a stunning save!
57' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

56' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) gets to the rebound on the edge of the penalty area and fires a shot towards the top left corner, but Sam Johnstone gets a hand to it and keeps it out. The ball is out of play. Manchester Utd win a corner kick.
56' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent. The referee blows his whistle, Manchester Utd are awarded a corner kick.

54' Raphael Varane is the provider with a good cross and Casemiro (Manchester United) shows great determination to get to the ball on the edge of the box, but he fires a shot well wide of the left post.
52' Manchester Utd control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
49' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
49' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Manchester Utd have been awarded a corner kick.
46' Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Sam Johnstone.
45+3' Joel Ward (Crystal Palace) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle. Manchester Utd are awarded a free kick from long range.
45+1' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
41' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) tries to find Facundo Pellistri, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
40' Casemiro (Manchester United) times his run into the box beautifully and plants a good looking header at goal from the corner, but the ball flashes just over the bar.
40' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
39' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. The ball goes out of play. Manchester Utd are awarded a corner kick.
38' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace).

38' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Crystal Palace will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
37' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) is able to continue to play.
35' The game is interrupted now, Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
35' Joachim Andersen (Crystal Palace) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
35' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
34' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. Crystal Palace earn a corner.
32' The referee can't ignore those comments and Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) sees a yellow card for bad language.
31' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) attempts to find Jean-Philippe Mateta with a delicate little through ball from inside the box, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
29' A lofted cross from Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
27' Casemiro (Manchester United) took a first-time shot from mid-range after he was put in the clear by a great pass, but the effort lacked a little accuracy and went just wide of the left post.
25' 0 - 1 Goal! Joachim Andersen (Crystal Palace) unleashes a first-time shot from inside the box and beats the goalkeeper into the roof of the net. 0:1.
25' It seemed like Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.

25' Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle after Sofyan Amrabat (Manchester United) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Crystal Palace are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
24' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
23' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) attempts to release Jeffrey Schlupp with a through ball, but his effort is thwarted by one of the defending players.
20' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 82:18.
17' Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) bangs the ball towards goal from the edge of the box, but it's rising all the way and sails high over the bar.
14' Raphael Varane (Manchester United) outjumps his marker on the edge of the 6-yard box and heads the resulting corner well wide of the right post.
14' Mason Mount (Manchester United) takes the corner.

14' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) wriggles into space inside the box with excellent ball control, but his effort on goal is well blocked. Manchester Utd force a corner. They send men into the box.
12' Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) fires the ball towards the right side of the goal from close-range, but his shot is blocked by one of the defenders.
11' What a chance that is! Joachim Andersen swings the ball into the box, and Marc Guehi (Crystal Palace) gets in front of his man and powers his header just wide of the right post.
11' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.

10' Chris Kavanagh shows a yellow card to Casemiro (Manchester United) for his blatant foul. Crystal Palace are awarded a free kick near the side line and the players make their way into the box for the inevitable cross.
7' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Sam Johnstone intercepts the ball.
6' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
3' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
2' The Manchester Utd players are exchanging some short passes.
